== Notes ==
* Be careful using this skill on [[hero]]es. If they accumulate [[death penalty]], or if for other reasons their maximum health drops below the health loss for this skill, they will use it regardless, killing themselves in the process. It may be wise to disable this on your heroes should they acquire death penalty.
* Has no [[duration]] (this is one of the few [[Upkeep#Skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep|skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep]]).
* You do not lose health again if you recast this enchantment before the initial casting expires.
* A damage [[packet]] must reduce you to less than 25% maximum health without killing you for the enchantment to trigger.
* If you cast this skill as soon as you are [[Resurrection|resurrected]] you will not lose health due to temporary invulnerability.
{{bug|Despite the skill descriptions, this skill heals rather than provide [[health gain]].}}
